mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.template_id, tp.title AS template_title, tp.cover_url AS template_cover_url, t.status, t.stage, t.failed_stage, t.failure_code, t.failure_reason, t.result_url, t.sim_config, t.created_at, t.started_at, t.finished_at, t.updated_at FROM tasks t JOIN templates tp ON tp.id = t.template_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (user_id, template_id, status, stage, sim_config) VALUES (#{userId}, #{templateId}, 'PENDING', NULL, #{simConfig})
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET status = 'PROCESSING', stage = #{stage}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, NOW(3)) WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')
UPDATE tasks SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_url = #{resultUrl}, finished_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND stage = 'RESULT_ORGANIZING'
UPDATE tasks SET status = 'FAILED', failed_stage = #{stage}, failure_code = #{code}, failure_reason = #{reason}, finished_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')

UPDATE tasks SET status = 'FAILED', failed_stage = stage, failure_code = 'ACCOUNT_DELETED', failure_reason = '账户已删除，任务已废弃', finished_at = NOW(3) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tasks WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
